definition: a medium of exchange used to buy and sell goods and services
hook: Money is named after a warning, not a coin.
modernAnchor: We chase it, count it, and worry over it, all under a name that began as a warning.

origin.originalMeaning: the one who warns, an epithet of the goddess Juno

journey: Juno Moneta, meaning Juno who warns, had a temple on Rome's Capitoline Hill.
Sometime after 269 BCE, the Romans built their official mint right beside her temple.
Workers began calling every coin moneta, after the goddess whose temple stood above them.
The mint eventually moved, but her name stayed on every coin that followed it.
